scope: Oasis capability crosswalk against the pinned WordCraft source inventory of 521 entries. Unmatched WordCraft rows remain unclassified; this is not a complete parity matrix. Per-capability dimension fields are added as their evidence is reviewed; category-level exposure, semantics, and persistence evidence remains in references.json and docs/ribbon-office-progress.md.

features.notes: Model selection is copied without document mutation. Browser checks use deterministic write adapters; native OS permissions/clipboard and full Safari workflows remain unverified. Access failures provide localized keyboard guidance.

Clipboard write must succeed before deletion, including the native event path. Tests cover denied writes, superseded async requests, read-only state and document replacement; browser adapters verify selection and one-step undo. Native OS/Safari permissions, tracked changes and DOCX fidelity remain unverified.

Captures effective paragraph/character appearance with direct overrides while preserving destination hyperlinks. Three browser engines exercise actual keyboard selection, one-shot disarm and undo/redo. Pointer/touch, real Safari/VoiceOver, complex stories and DOCX/PDF remain unverified.

Continuous mode survives two finalized keyboard targets and its own batched transactions. Browser checks exercise Escape, read-only and document-replacement cancellation; client selection-only changes retain source identity. Pointer/touch, complex stories and DOCX/PDF remain unverified.

Shared rich/HTML paste preserves the captured API target, with localized failure feedback and a one-use native keyboard fallback. Chromium/Firefox/WebKit use deterministic clipboard adapters and synthetic native events; real OS prompts, image-only behavior, long-document workflows and DOCX fidelity remain unverified.

Destination character/paragraph styles and source emphasis/links are retained. Deterministic browser adapters and synthetic native events exercise merge and one-step undo. Real OS/Safari behavior, mixed lists/nested tables and DOCX round-trips remain unverified.

Immediate text-only action; unavailable or rejected Clipboard API offers localized keyboard guidance instead of a silent disabled action. A single native paste consumes the text-only choice; document replacement/dismissal expires it. Real OS/Safari behavior remains unverified.
Find pane command is wired; search/replacement interaction still needs E2E verification.
Selections spanning tables and document stories require E2E verification.

Bold command is bound to the Home Font button. Delivery 7 covers inherited-style toggles, selection preservation and one-step undo/redo across the Font workflows; mixed-state presentation, Word-open interoperability and Safari/VoiceOver remain unverified.

Italic command is bound to the Home Font button. Delivery 7 covers inherited-style toggles, selection preservation and one-step undo/redo across the Font workflows; mixed-state presentation, Word-open interoperability and Safari/VoiceOver remain unverified.

The custom Underline split control dispatches the atomic applyUnderlineStyle command. Its main click toggles the last selected variant; WordCraft format.underline activates Single by default, so reusing a prior Double style is a known behavior difference and this is a related-task mapping. Delivery 4 covers apply/remove and one-step undo; mixed states and Word-open interoperability remain unverified.

The Double Underline option in the custom split menu dispatches applyUnderlineStyle with the double variant. Delivery 4 covers atomic variant replacement, selection preservation and one-step undo/redo; mixed states, Word-open interoperability and VoiceOver remain unverified.

Subscript command is bound to the Home Font button. Delivery 7 covers inherited-style resets, script mutual exclusion and keyboard editing across the Font workflows; mixed-state presentation, Word-open interoperability and Safari/VoiceOver remain unverified.

Superscript command is bound to the Home Font button. Delivery 7 covers inherited-style resets, script mutual exclusion and keyboard editing across the Font workflows; mixed-state presentation, Word-open interoperability and Safari/VoiceOver remain unverified.

Decrease Indent is bound to the Home Paragraph button. This is a related task, not a complete command equivalent: Oasis changes list nesting only, while WordCraft also adjusts non-list paragraph indentation. Table/list combinations, mixed selections, undo and DOCX/PDF output need workflow verification.

Increase Indent is bound to the Home Paragraph button. This is a related task, not a complete command equivalent: Oasis changes list nesting only, while WordCraft also adjusts non-list paragraph indentation. Table/list combinations, mixed selections, undo and DOCX/PDF output need workflow verification.
Align Left is bound to the Home Paragraph button. Mixed/multiple paragraph selection, table cells, keyboard behavior, undo and DOCX/PDF output need workflow verification.
Center is bound to the Home Paragraph button. Mixed/multiple paragraph selection, table cells, keyboard behavior, undo and DOCX/PDF output need workflow verification.
Align Right is bound to the Home Paragraph button. Mixed/multiple paragraph selection, table cells, keyboard behavior, undo and DOCX/PDF output need workflow verification.
The Home font-family selector applies a font to the current text selection. East Asian font selection, fallback behavior, selection preservation and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.
The Home font-size selector applies a size to selected text. Mixed-size selection, units, keyboard editing and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.
Increase Font Size is bound to the Home Font button. Step sizes, selection preservation and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.
Decrease Font Size is bound to the Home Font button. Step sizes, selection preservation and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.

The Change Case menu exposes sentence, lower, upper, capitalize and toggle actions. Oasis capitalize and WordCraft title modes may differ; Unicode, locale-specific casing, undo and selection behavior need workflow verification.
Clear All Formatting is bound to the Home Font button. Character versus paragraph formatting, collapsed-caret behavior, style inheritance and undo need workflow verification.
Strikethrough is bound to the Home Font button. Mixed selections, inherited styles, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.
Font Color is bound to the Home Font color picker. Automatic color, theme colors, recent-color behavior and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.
Text Highlight Color is bound to the Home Font highlight picker. Palette equivalence, clearing, mixed selections and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.
Character Shading maps to the Home text-shading picker. Color values, clearing, distinction from text highlighting and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.

Bullets is bound to the Home Paragraph button. Bullet libraries and per-list marker choices are separate workflows; mixed selections, nesting, numbering preservation and DOCX interoperability need verification.
Numbering is bound to the Home Paragraph button. Numbering formats, list continuation, mixed selections, nesting and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.
The list options control can set a numbering start value, including 1. WordCraft provides a dedicated restart action; shared-list continuation and DOCX behavior need workflow verification.
Justify is bound to the Home Paragraph button. Mixed/multiple paragraph selection, table cells, keyboard behavior, undo and DOCX/PDF output need workflow verification.

The line-spacing menu exposes multiple line-height presets and a dialog. WordCraft also supports at-least and exact point values; these modes, spacing, mixed selections and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.

The line-spacing dialog accepts a spacing-before value. WordCraft exposes a one-click toggle; entering its default value in Oasis is a related workflow, and units, selection and DOCX interoperability need verification.

The line-spacing dialog accepts a spacing-after value. WordCraft exposes a one-click removal; entering zero in Oasis is a related workflow, and units, selection and DOCX interoperability need verification.
The Home style gallery dispatches paragraph styles through setStyleId. Style coverage, built-in IDs, preview fidelity, selection behavior and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.

Related task: Oasis exposes a Home style gallery that applies paragraph styles, while WordCraft's Styles Pane is a separate management surface. The gallery does not establish style creation, modification, inspection or management parity; style coverage and DOCX round-trip need workflow verification.

Related display only: Oasis shows the total word count in its status bar, while WordCraft's Review command opens a detailed word-count view. Selection-scoped counts and pages/characters/paragraphs statistics are not provided by this status item.

Related control only: Oasis exposes a status-bar zoom slider rather than WordCraft's Zoom dialog. The View tab has no zoom group; slider presets, layout modes, current value and keyboard/focus behavior need workflow verification.
Related control only: the Oasis slider accepts 100% as an arbitrary zoom value but offers no dedicated 100% command or preset button. Exact value entry, focus and keyboard behavior need verification.

Related control only: Oasis provides a status-bar plus button that increases document zoom by a fixed step. The step sequence differs from any unverified WordCraft preset behavior; keyboard access and center anchoring need workflow verification.

Related control only: Oasis provides a status-bar minus button that reduces document zoom by a fixed step. The step sequence differs from any unverified WordCraft preset behavior; keyboard access and center anchoring need workflow verification.

Related navigation only: Oasis exposes document headings in a collapsible Outline panel, while WordCraft's Navigation Pane also includes search and page navigation. Those other tasks, focus behavior and heading-navigation equivalence need workflow verification.

Related display only: Oasis shows a horizontal ruler with margin and indent markers when editor chrome is visible. It has no user-facing visibility toggle or vertical ruler, so this does not match WordCraft's Ruler toggle.

Related presentation only: Oasis lays the document out as pages with paper dimensions, margins and page breaks. It is the canvas's default presentation, not a selectable View mode; Web Layout, Read Mode and switching between view modes are not provided. Page-level rendering and print/DOCX fidelity need workflow verification.

The registered sortParagraphs command sorts a contiguous run of sibling paragraphs by natural number/text order and refuses ranges containing tables or footnote content. WordCraft para.sort serves the same paragraph-sorting task, but collates using the document language while Oasis currently uses runtime localeCompare. No default Ribbon or menubar entry exposes the command; DOCX/PDF reorder behavior and multilingual equivalence remain unverified.

Both commands apply a single 1.5 pt bottom border to paragraphs in the selection. The Oasis command has no default Ribbon or menubar entry; selection scope, border-color behavior, undo and DOCX/PDF round-trip still need workflow verification.
Pagination and multi-section round-trip are not certified by the Ribbon binding alone.

Related task only: Oasis exposes a page break on Insert, while WordCraft Blank Page inserts a blank page. A page break starts following content on a new page but does not by itself guarantee a full blank page; pagination and DOCX behavior need workflow verification.

The Insert grid picker dispatches row and column counts to the shared table command. Draw Table, text conversion, Quick Tables and spreadsheet insertion are separate WordCraft tasks; table selection, accessibility and DOCX round-trip remain independently unverified.

Inserts a local image through the host file picker and the shared image command. Online pictures, screenshots, 3D models, icons and SmartArt are distinct WordCraft tasks; format, size and round-trip workflows remain open.
Opens the URL dialog for the selected range. In-document target selection, keyboard/focus behavior, undo and DOCX hyperlink round-trip remain independently unverified.
Removes the hyperlink from the selected linked text through the shared command. Mixed ranges, selection retention, undo and DOCX round-trip remain independently unverified.

The Shape Gallery inserts Oasis's supported preset subset through the shared shape command. Broader WordCraft shape kinds, geometry editing, arrangement, accessibility, rendering and DOCX round-trip remain open.

Related task: the Oasis Symbols menu inserts its curated symbol/number subset as text and opens a broader symbol dialog. Per-symbol font selection and the full WordCraft symbol command contract are not established.

Equation templates in the Insert/Symbols menu dispatch the shared equation command. WordCraft also lists this command on its contextual Equation tab; Oasis does not yet expose an equivalent contextual surface. Full editing, navigation, rendering and OMML interoperability remain unverified.
TOC creation, fields and export/round-trip remain independently testable.
Eligibility and missing-TOC command states still need refinement.
The References action inserts a footnote at the current editing position. Focus restoration, multi-section behavior and DOCX interoperability remain independently unverified.

Related task: Oasis exposes image caption insertion only when an image is selected, under Insert/Accessibility. WordCraft's caption command also covers tables and is placed under References; placement and target coverage differ.
Active state is wired to EditorState; tracked content fidelity and UI workflows remain to verify.

Related task to WordCraft Previous Change. Oasis cycles backward through text-run revisions in the active editing story; structural, table and section changes need separate navigation support. Pure selection navigation; parity remains partial.

Related task to WordCraft Next Change. Oasis cycles forward through tracked text-run revisions in the active editing story; structural, table and section changes need separate navigation support. Pure selection navigation; parity remains partial.

Related task to WordCraft Show Comments: Oasis toggles an editor-scoped discussion drawer, while WordCraft's command returns the comment list. The drawer lists roots and nested replies, supports text search, open/resolved filters, navigation, moderation and confirmation before deletion. The Activity view shows undoable local comment events, which are not exported to DOCX. Host IDs gate mutations; visual parity remains partial.

Creates an authored comment anchored to selected text or a caret word, through a per-editor modal. Uses native comment registry and is undoable; visual E2E and full DOCX import/export fidelity are pending. WordCraft also places this action on Insert; Oasis currently exposes it on Review only, so placement parity remains open.

Creates a threaded reply linked to its parent comment; Oasis stores the reply in an unanchored comment story linked by parentId. DOCX commentsExtended XML parent relationship has unit coverage; cross-application round-trip remains unverified.

Edits only the selected existing comment's text in a transactional modal; ID, author, creation time, anchors, resolved state and reply links are preserved. Popup actions support editing individual nested replies. DOCX export/reimport and read-only gating have tests; full visual WordCraft parity remains unverified.
Navigates to the prior anchored comment in the active story, skipping unanchored replies and wrapping.
Navigates to the next anchored comment without changing the document; Mapped to WordCraft `review.nextComment`; semantic and persistence parity remain unverified.
Marks the comment under the selection as resolved, retaining the DOCX comment id, author, anchors and thread metadata. Needs round-trip E2E.
Reopens a resolved comment under the selection. Enabled only when the selected comment is resolved.
Removes an anchored comment and recursively removes replies to prevent orphan thread parent ids. Undo and DOCX source-package E2E remain to verify.
Selection scope and disabled states for documents without revisions need tests.
Selection scope and disabled states for documents without revisions need tests.
Oasis-specific display option with active state bound to EditorState.
Paragraph-mark display feedback is wired; rendering and accessibility require E2E checks.
Oasis precise-font mode; platform font availability still requires coverage.
Enters the default header editing zone for the active section. First/even-page variant in-place editing and brand-new header part export remain follow-ups.
Enters the default footer editing zone for the active section. Variant in-place editing and brand-new footer part export remain follow-ups.

Inserts a PAGE field at the caret inside a header/footer (or body). Field formatting (\* roman etc.) resolves in layout and round-trips through DOCX. Per-section start/format (w:pgNumType) is set via the setSectionPageNumbering payload command. Layout resolution E2E verification remains.
Inserts the Page X of Y combination (PAGE + NUMPAGES with literals) at the caret, mirroring WordCraft insert.page_number format=of, with an optional \* number format.
Places the active section's default header as a single centered PAGE paragraph (mirrors WordCraft insert.page_number position=top story rewrite). Alignment gallery is not yet exposed in UI.
Places the active section's default footer as a single centered PAGE paragraph (mirrors WordCraft insert.page_number position=bottom story rewrite). Round-trips through DOCX with alignment.

Bookmarks the current selection (single point when collapsed) into the document-level EditorBookmarks registry, exported as w:bookmarkStart/w:bookmarkEnd and round-tripped on import. Cross-reference insertion (PAGEREF/REF with refresh) remains a follow-up.

Inserts a typed DATE field at the caret with a \@ picture (default M/d/yyyy), caching the formatted result in the run text and round-tripping through DOCX. The DATE_FORMATS picture gallery and TIME fields remain follow-ups.
Returns the caret to the section body when editing a header/footer zone. Enabled only while the active zone is a header or footer.

Both commands insert a nonbreaking space at the current editing position. The Oasis command is registered without a default Ribbon or menubar entry; selection replacement, caret behavior and DOCX/PDF round-trip need direct workflow evidence.

Both commands insert U+2011 at the current editing position. Oasis has no default Ribbon or menubar entry; DOCX serialization/import recognizes w:noBreakHyphen, but selection, caret and end-to-end round-trip behavior still need workflow verification.

Both implementations model automatic hyphenation, zone, capital-word handling and consecutive-line limit. Oasis applies settings to layout and imports/exports the corresponding DOCX settings; no default Ribbon or menubar entry exposes the command, and rendered pagination plus complete round-trip behavior still need workflow evidence.

The File tab creates a blank document and confirms before discarding a dirty document. WordCraft's template selection and new-document options are not provided; confirmation, dirty-state and lifecycle workflows remain in P04.

Save invokes the public client host persistence contract; the default app uses IndexedDB, and a custom host can persist elsewhere. The command clears dirty state after success and logs failures, while visible completion/error feedback and full save/reload/recovery workflows remain open in P04.

The File tab opens the DOCX import picker. Arbitrary document opening and other source formats are not provided by this path; cancellation, import errors, source preservation and full lifecycle workflows remain in P04/P06.
No document-template picker or command is exposed in the File tab, menubar, or core command registry. Style galleries select formatting presets; they do not create documents from templates.
No save-as-template command or user-facing template workflow was found in the File tab, menubar, or core command registry.
No personal-template library or list-templates workflow was found in the File tab, menubar, or core command registry.

The File tab offers DOCX export as a related Save As path, downloading a copy instead of selecting an arbitrary host location or updating the active persistence record. Format choice, overwrite behavior and full save lifecycle remain open in P04/P06.
Print Markup: Oasis exposes browser/host Print but has no print-markup toggle or revision-markup print path in the File tab or print handler.
Close: No document-close command or File close action exists in the default app; the host owns editor disposal. Header/footer close exits a story and is not document close.
Info: No Backstage information page or command exists. Status-bar counts and the outline do not provide the source File Info workflow.
Properties: No document-properties page or command exists in the File tab, menubar, or built-in command registry.
Export Image: No document/page-to-PNG export workflow exists in File, menubar, or built-in commands; image export and screenshot utilities are not document export.
Options: No application Options/Preferences page is available through the default File or menubar surfaces. Hidden Tools/Preferences metadata has no visible action.
Numerals: No numeral-display settings command or user-facing control exists in the default app surfaces or built-in command registry.
Share: No document-sharing workflow, share link, or collaboration service action is exposed in the default app or built-in commands.
Protect Document: The declared Protection tab has no populated default controls or protection command; no document restriction workflow is exposed.
Inspect Document: No document inspector workflow is exposed through the File tab, menubar, or built-in commands.
Check Accessibility: Alt text and accessible controls exist, but no document accessibility-checker workflow or command is exposed.
Check Compatibility: No document compatibility checker or compatibility report workflow exists in the default app or built-in commands.
Version History: No saved-version history or restore-version workflow is exposed. Stepwise undo is not document version history.
Recover Unsaved: No unsaved-document recovery browser or recovery command is exposed; IndexedDB persistence is not an end-user recovery workflow.
Oasis exposes stepwise Undo/Redo only. The Home history group has no undo-history menu, and the public client history API provides undo/redo but no jump-to-entry operation.
No repeat-last-command action or public command exists in the default toolbar, menubar, or built-in command registry. Redo is a distinct history operation and is not treated as equivalent.
Oasis exposes Print in File > Document through the host/browser print flow. Page breaks, print settings, cancellation/errors, keyboard access and actual Safari output need workflow verification.
Oasis exposes PDF export in File > Document. Long documents, page-level features, output integrity, failure/cancel behavior and visual comparisons still need workflow verification.

Oasis places Undo in Home > History while WordCraft exposes it in Quick Access. Shared history dispatch is wired; transaction scope, disabled state, keyboard parity and multi-step user workflows need verification.

Oasis places Redo in Home > History while WordCraft exposes it in Quick Access. Shared history dispatch is wired; transaction scope, disabled state, keyboard parity and multi-step user workflows need verification.

Oasis exposes Edit Header from the Insert > Header & Footer menu. WordCraft also places it on its contextual Header & Footer tab; variant editing, selection/focus behavior and DOCX story round-trip need verification.

Oasis exposes Edit Footer from the Insert > Header & Footer menu. WordCraft also places it on its contextual Header & Footer tab; variant editing, selection/focus behavior and DOCX story round-trip need verification.
Oasis registers a hard-line-break command but no default Ribbon/menubar control or shortcut was found. Selection/caret behavior, undo and DOCX break round-trip need verification.
Oasis registers a hard-column-break command but no default Ribbon/menubar control or shortcut was found. Column layout, selection/caret behavior, undo and DOCX break round-trip need verification.

WordCraft para.shading shades selected text when the selection is within one paragraph; Oasis exposes character shading in Home > Font. This covers that scope of the context-sensitive command, while paragraph scope is tracked separately. Mixed ranges, clear behavior, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.

features.uiPath: Layout > Paragraph metrics dropdown > Paragraph shading
features.notes: WordCraft para.shading applies paragraph shading at a caret or when explicitly requested; Oasis exposes a paragraph-color field in the Layout metrics dropdown and also a field in the Paragraph dialog. The control does not provide WordCraft's combined text/paragraph scope or palette workflow; mixed selections, clearing, undo and DOCX interoperability need verification.

features.uiPath: Layout > Paragraph metrics dropdown > Apply borders to paragraph
features.notes: The Oasis quick action applies a 1 pt solid black border on all four paragraph sides. WordCraft para.borders offers individual sides, presets, styles, widths and colors, so this is only a related task; per-side formatting is available separately in the Paragraph dialog. Selection scope, undo and DOCX/PDF output need verification.

features.uiPath: Context menu > Paragraph dialog > Borders and shading
features.notes: The Paragraph dialog commits configurable sides, one shared style, width and color through a dialog transaction, with no shared Oasis command for the full payload. WordCraft also supports independent per-side styles, between borders and more styles; undo grouping and DOCX/PDF behavior need workflow verification.

The Home special-indent menu exposes Hanging. WordCraft adds 36 pt to the existing left indent; the Oasis menu sets a 36 pt hanging indent by default, so repeated use and paragraphs with existing indents can differ. Selection scope, undo and DOCX/PDF behavior need verification.

Oasis registers a command that sets the selected list paragraphs' explicit level from 0–8, matching WordCraft's task; no default Ribbon or menubar control exposes the numeric level. Mixed list selections, numbering definitions, undo and DOCX interoperability need verification.

The List Options start field sets a numbering start value. WordCraft creates a numbering override that continues across following paragraphs sharing that list; Oasis updates the selected paragraphs' start value, so continuation and selection scope differ. Undo and DOCX behavior need workflow verification.

Oasis registers the Kinsoku setting as a separate command, but no default Ribbon, menu or dialog control was found. Its behavior, Japanese line-breaking output, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification against WordCraft's combined Asian Typography command.

Oasis registers the East Asian word-wrap setting as a separate command, but no default Ribbon, menu or dialog control was found. Its behavior, mixed-script line breaking, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification against WordCraft's combined Asian Typography command.

Oasis registers punctuation overflow as a separate command, but no default Ribbon, menu or dialog control was found. Rendering, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification against WordCraft's combined Asian Typography command.

Oasis registers top-line punctuation compression as a separate command, but no default Ribbon, menu or dialog control was found. Rendering, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification against WordCraft's combined Asian Typography command.

Oasis registers automatic spacing between East Asian text and numbers as a separate command, but no default Ribbon, menu or dialog control was found. Font/run handling, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification against WordCraft's combined Asian Typography command.

Oasis opens its Paragraph dialog from the editor context menu; WordCraft exposes a Paragraph dialog launcher on Home and Layout. The entry point is UI-only and the dialog does not share WordCraft's command contract. Field coverage, selection scope, undo and document round-trips remain independently tracked.

Oasis opens the Font dialog from the editor context menu; WordCraft exposes a Font dialog launcher on Home. The entry point is UI-only and does not share a launcher command. Font and Advanced tab fields are tracked separately; field coverage, selection scope, undo and DOCX behavior remain to be verified.

Normal is selectable from Oasis's Home style gallery through setStyleId. WordCraft also provides a dedicated Normal command and shortcut; style ID/name resolution, inherited formatting, selection scope and DOCX interoperability need verification.

Heading 1 is selectable from Oasis's Home style gallery through setStyleId. WordCraft also provides a dedicated Heading 1 command and shortcut; style ID/name resolution, outline/navigation behavior, selection scope and DOCX interoperability need verification.

Heading 2 is selectable from Oasis's Home style gallery through setStyleId. WordCraft also provides a dedicated Heading 2 command and shortcut; style ID/name resolution, outline/navigation behavior, selection scope and DOCX interoperability need verification.

Heading 3 is selectable from Oasis's Home style gallery through setStyleId. WordCraft also provides a dedicated Heading 3 command and shortcut; style ID/name resolution, outline/navigation behavior, selection scope and DOCX interoperability need verification.

Oasis's Home style gallery applies character styles through setCharacterStyleId and lists quick styles. Style availability filtering, name/ID resolution, mixed selections, reset behavior, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.

WordCraft styles.apply with a paragraph-style payload maps to Oasis's paragraph-style gallery path. WordCraft's no-payload branch opens a Styles pane that Oasis does not expose; style application, inherited formatting, selection behavior and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.

WordCraft styles.apply with a character-style payload maps to Oasis's character-style gallery path. WordCraft's no-payload branch opens a Styles pane that Oasis does not expose; style availability, selection behavior, clearing, undo and DOCX interoperability need workflow verification.

The Oasis Find button opens a dialog with match-case and whole-word filters. WordCraft Advanced Find also supports prefix/suffix matching, ignored punctuation/spacing, wildcards, regex, special codes, selection scope and match highlighting; those paths are not represented in Oasis.

The Find dialog advances to the next match through its controller, and Enter invokes the same action. Oasis has no shared find-next command; wraparound, selection retention and parity with WordCraft's additional search options need workflow verification.

The Find dialog moves to the previous match through its controller, and Shift+Enter invokes the same action. Oasis has no shared find-previous command; wraparound, selection retention and parity with WordCraft's additional search options need workflow verification.

Replace one applies the replacement term to the active match through the dialog controller. WordCraft's edit.replace accepts a direct search/replacement payload with advanced options; Oasis has no shared command bound to this UI action. Selection, formatting preservation, undo and DOCX behavior need workflow verification.

Replace all runs through the dialog controller and supports match-case and whole-word filters. The separate Oasis replaceAll command is not dispatched by this UI; WordCraft also supports regex/special codes and a wider option set. A single undo step, formatting, selection and DOCX behavior need workflow verification.

Oasis registers Reject All Changes but no default Ribbon, menu or dialog control was found. Confirmation, protected revisions, comment anchors, undo and DOCX round-trip need workflow verification.

Convert Text to Table: No command converts delimited document text into a table in the default app. The Insert table grid creates an empty table and is a different task.
Excel Spreadsheet: No embedded spreadsheet insertion or Excel integration is exposed in the default app.
Quick Tables: The default Insert tab has no preformatted Quick Tables gallery; the table grid inserts a blank table.
Online Pictures: Oasis can insert a local image, but no online image search/source picker is exposed in the default app.
3D Models: No 3D model importer, viewer or insertion workflow is exposed.
SmartArt: No SmartArt diagram model or insertion workflow is exposed in the default app.
Chart: No chart data model or chart insertion workflow is exposed in the default app.

Drawing Canvas: The editor uses a canvas renderer, but it does not expose an insertable Drawing Canvas object or drawing-area workflow.
Get Add-ins: No add-in store, discovery surface or add-in installation workflow is exposed in the default app.
Online Video: No online video embed or media insertion workflow is exposed.
Cross-reference: No cross-reference insertion dialog or command is exposed in the default UI. Citation links and heading navigation are separate tasks.

Quick Parts: No reusable building-block gallery or insertion workflow is exposed in the default app.
AutoText: No named reusable text-snippet library or insertion workflow is exposed.
Document Property: No document metadata field picker or insertable property control is exposed. Date and page fields are separate supported field types.

WordArt: No decorative text gallery or WordArt insertion workflow is exposed. Shape text styling does not provide WordArt presets and transforms.
Oasis registers the drop-cap setter and model support, but no default Ribbon or dialog control exposes it. Visual, selection and DOCX behavior need workflow verification.
Signature Line: No signature-request placeholder or signing workflow is exposed in the default app.
Object: No embedded-object or OLE insertion workflow is exposed in the default app.
Text from File: DOCX import replaces/loads a document; no workflow inserts another file’s text at the current selection.

Oasis registers an optional-hyphen insertion command, but no default Ribbon, menu or dialog control exposes it. Rendering, line breaking and DOCX round-trip need verification.

Icons: The default Insert tab exposes shapes and symbols, but no searchable Office icon asset gallery or SVG icon insertion workflow.

Paragraph Spacing: The Design gallery applies a preset paragraph-spacing profile. Per-style spacing, full line-spacing controls and DOCX round-trip need workflow verification.
Effects: The Design gallery applies a bundled effects preset. Word’s full document-effects set and rendering interoperability remain unverified.
